interpretation_limits: The common proton free energy cancels; absolute protonation free energies and pKa are not reported.
The conformer sum is truncated to structures selected by the electronic-energy window.
One representative per geometric cluster is counted once; unknown basin degeneracy is not included.
GFN2-xTB/ALPB and modified-RRHO errors may exceed the reported Bz/SB difference.
